title: Executive - SCCM Administrator
jobDescription:
Job Title: Executive SCCM Administrator Designation : Executive / Sr. Executive Company: Hitachi India Pvt Ltd. Location: Delhi/ Bangalore, India Salary: As per Industry Company Overview: Hitachi India Pvt. Ltd. (HIL) markets and sells a wide range of products/services ranging from Information & Telecommunications Systems, Digital Solutions & Services, Infrastructure Systems, Industrial Systems like Water, Oil & Gas supply and management to Transportation and Urban Development Systems. Together with further localization, Hitachi aims to contribute to developing a sustainable society in India as well as contributing to the country's economic growth. Job Roles &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. MECM experience- Administer and maintain Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) infrastructure Maintain SCCM client health, collections, boundary groups, and configuration baselines Experience with modern endpoint management tools, including Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and Hybrid Azure AD Join, to support future cloud-based management strategies Perform general MECM administration and troubleshooting. Creating reports using SCCM reporting and SQL 2012 management studio. Upgraded knowledge on MECM knowledge of Active Directory, DNS and DHCP and their relation to a MECM Environment (IIS, BITS and SQL Database). Perform daily administration tasks and best practices on MS MECM, managing collections, packages, advertisements, and reporting. Installing SCCM 2012 & 1902, MECM 1910 & 2010 clients using client push installation and client remediation script. Resolving issues related to SCCM client installation. Maintained SCCM client troubleshooting skills on Windows 10 & Windows 11 platforms. Provide monthly reporting of patching activity and work with local teams to resolve patching issues Daily checking health checkup report and performing troubleshooting failure DP content, Patch deployment status and Site components. Daily Handling of incidents, Patch exception request tasks related to troubleshooting of SCCM client installation, software distribution and other SCCM issues, and Software updates on the client side. Checking the Server-side log files and Client-side log files for troubleshooting the issues.
2. Packaging- Working on software distribution and Application & patch management. Under supervision, create Collections/Applications/Software Update Group within an SCCM 2012 and 1902, MECM 1910 environment. Creating packages & Applications for Application deployments. Creation of query collections as per custom requirements. Support for package distributions. Software Applications deployment through MECM to pilot systems then rolled out in production.
3. Intune- Basic Troubleshooting Knowledge in all Intune-related issues. Experience in Deploying Windows applications through Intune. Experience: L3 Experience 7 to 10 Years Hitachi Values: We are proud to say we are an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to any factor that doesn’t impact your ability to do the job, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are proud of Japanese heritage, with our values expressed through the Hitachi Spirit: Wa – Harmony, Trust, Respect Makoto – Sincerity, Fairness, Honesty, Integrity Kaitakusha-Seishin – Pioneering Spirit, Challenge

title: Assistant Manager - Market Researcher
jobDescription:
Assistant Manager
- Market Researcher Grade: Assistant Manager Salary : As per the industry Type of Employment: Fixed Term Contract Company Overview: Hitachi India Pvt. Ltd. (HIL) markets and sells a wide range of products/services ranging from Information & Telecommunications Systems, Digital Solutions & Services, Infrastructure Systems, Industrial Systems like Water, Oil & Gas supply and management to Transportation and Urban Development Systems. Together with further localization, Hitachi aims to contribute to developing a sustainable society in India as well as contributing to the country's economic growth. Job Roles &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Support the research activities of Hitachi Research Institute (HRI), which is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. The activities include, but not limited to, the followings: Collect and organize the information on macroeconomy, government policy/ geopolitics, finance, technology, industry, and energy & environment in India as well as other regions globally. Identify critical uncertainties for Hitachi, and opportunity/threat for Hitachi through the comparison with the present status of business strategy of Hitachi and competitor benchmarking. Work out the measures to capture opportunities and reduce threats Supervise junior researcher in the team in India. Required Qualification and Characteristics: Master’s degree in economics/ commerce/ business from a reputed college or university. 7+ years of related work experience preferably with a market research/ consulting/ credit rating firm or strategy/ corporate office of multinational company. Ability to handle research & consultancy assignments independently including writing research proposal, conducting research (secondary, primary), report writing, communication with Hitachi businesses. Open to travel both domestic and foreign. Strong Microsoft Office skills (Power Point, Word, Excel), ability to use AI for research works. Team management and good interpersonal skills for team building, stakeholder management. About HRI: Hitachi Research Institute (HRI) is internal strategic think-tank of Hitachi Ltd. It provides research and consulting to Hitachi Corporate, Business Units, and Group Companies globally. The business fields include the following: Research of social issues, like economy, society, environment and industry. Comprehensive research and consulting on management issues. Insight and analysis of market and business segments. Working in India Office, you will find yourself in a team-based environment with Hitachi India Pvt. Ltd. and will engage with Tokyo head office of HRI remotely via online meetings. The encouragement and exchange of ideas will promote on-the-job learning in an environment that requires good judgment and fosters teamwork, responsibility and professional growth. For further details refer the website: http://www.hitachi-hri.com/english/ Our Values We are proud to say we are an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to any factor that doesn’t impact your ability to do the job, including race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. We are proud of Japanese heritage, with our values expressed through the Hitachi Spirit: Wa – Harmony, Trust, Respect Makoto – Sincerity, Fairness, Honesty, Integrity Kaitakusha-Seishin – Pioneering Spirit, Challenge If, like us, you’re motivated by delivering first class services, thrive in a fast paced and supportive environment and want to help Hitachi to drive social innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Global Payroll Administration Specialist (US Payroll)
jobDescription: Global Payroll Administration Specialist (US) Grade: Associate Location: Bangalore, Karnataka Salary Range: As per the industry Our Company Since its founding in 1910, Hitachi has supported the development of society and the improvement of people's lives. Throughout the world, Hitachi Group employees exemplify outstanding teamwork that transcends the boundaries of geographical regions and business fields. Together, we share the Hitachi group identity and put it into practice worldwide. At this exciting time in our growth Hitachi has established its Centralized Shared Services (CSS) function to be the strategic partner for transforming and delivering business operations across the Hitachi group. With a mission to deliver the best experience to employees and customers you will be joining a global team known for excellence and innovation. What you’ll be doing : The Payroll Administration Specialist is responsible for providing global or region-specific payroll operations support. They collect key data inputs from various teams (e.g., Benefits, Compensation, Mobility) to administer the disbursement of pay. The Payroll Administration Specialist is the face of payroll to Hitachi employees, working with third party payroll suppliers, Total Rewards COE, and BU HR to answer and resolve queries. The Payroll Specialist ensures that Hitachi employees get paid in a timely fashion, and that Hitachi is disbursing pay in compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies. This role will be a mixture of remote working and based on Hitachi’s office in Bangalore. What you bring to the team : We’re looking for a Specialist, who is motivated by delivering great work and the Hitachi vision. Some of the skills and experience we look for includes: Creates, updates, and maintains employee assignment and pay details Analyzes all off-cycle payroll requests and validates payroll inquiry/requests Processes regular and off-cycle payroll and distribute payments Processes payroll accounting and reconciliation Partners with third party payroll supplier as applicable Ensures Payroll Service Level Agreements are met with internal customers Monitor metrics/KPIs, gather customer feedback, and determine areas for improvement Partners with the Total Rewards COE to conduct quarter and year-end activities including preparation of interfaces and reports Provides support for Legal and regulatory reports Acts as a point of escalation for payroll inquiries, redirecting complex or unusual inquiries to Payroll Administration Lead, BU HR, and/or Total Rewards COE Preferred Qualification Responsible for payroll processing and ensuring timely and accurate processing of payroll transactions including salaries, benefits, taxes, and other deductions including timely F&F of exits. Having excellent knowledge in US payroll, multistate payroll processing and statutory compliance. Good exposure in US year end process. Have experience in processing payroll in ADP WFN/Workday Our Values : We are proud to say we are an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to any factor that doesn’t impact your ability to do the job, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are proud of Japanese heritage, with our values expressed through the Hitachi Spirit: Wa – Harmony, Trust, Respect Makoto – Sincerity, Fairness, Honesty, Integrity Kaitakusha-Seishin – Pioneering Spirit, Challenge If, like us, you’re motivated by delivering first class services, thrive in a fast paced and supportive environment and want to help Hitachi to drive social innovation, we’d love to hear from you.
